tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.model: GPT-4-class models run inside Microsoft's service boundary
data_allowed: Email and Teams inside the tenant
data_prohibited: Client Social Security numbers outside Ledgerline
tools.rule: Approved. Client data stays inside the tenant and the vendor does not train on it (contract terms).

tools.name: ChatGPT (Team plan)
tools.discovered_via: Entra sign-in logs (Sign in with Microsoft)
tools.rule: Approved on the Team plan only; personal accounts are blocked at sign-in.

tools.name: Claude
data_allowed: Code and documentation without client data
tools.rule: Engineering asked for a team plan; contract terms under review by the Privacy Lead.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.rule: Approved for the portal repositories; secret scanning stays on.

tools.name: Grammarly
data_allowed: Email and document text classified Public or Internal
tools.rule: Approved; disabled in the payroll operations SharePoint site.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.rule: Blocked Oct 10: records client calls with no consent step and no retention rule. Teams recap is the approved alternative.

tools.name: Zapier Agents
data_allowed: Ticket creation from the payroll mailbox (proposed)
data_prohibited: Reading mail beyond the payroll@ mailbox
tools.rule: An agent reads the payroll inbox and creates tickets. Needs a scoped mailbox, a DPA addendum and a log of its actions before approval.

tools.name: Ledgerline Assist
tools.rule: Vendor turned it on for all customers on Oct 20. Ask for the AI addendum to the DPA and confirm no training on client data; clients are told through the transparency notice (CTL-40).

tools.name: Fireflies.ai
tools.rule: Blocked for the same reasons as Otter.ai.

tools.name: HubSpot Breeze
data_prohibited: Client payroll data (never in the CRM)
tools.rule: Approved; the CRM holds no payroll data by policy.
